prior: Y-NCI04 original independent 72-case audit demonstrated the functional single-valued original StatePool writer preserves 24/24 nonfork two-hop paths yet loses root and internal forks 0/24 despite 72/72 exact multigraph oracle and zero external models.
hypothesis: Will a small fixed seven-active-edge multi-valued native StatePool writer, connected to unchanged Y-NCI02 native learned text admission and join predicate, restore task performance on novel root/internal/dual fork and nonfork graphs across interrupted state and one added fact?
freeze: Use existing native StatePool (576 bytes), fixed seven active/nine retained and original Torch learned admission 4 params and join 6 params. Compare baseline old one-valued writer against experimental exact edge-preserving writer without additional learned parameters or changes to graph enumeration. Four novel six-edge motifs and a seventh learned edge after checkpoint. Distinct sealed seeds24640..24663 ×4 motifs=96. Same candidate learned join and query semantics for both arms, original graph oracle separately hard-coded. One original source first-use.
primary: BOUNDED_MULTIEDGE_STORAGE_RESTORES_CODED_COMPOSITION iff for all four motifs every seven native multiedge tasks (2/3-hop positive, negative, interruption, retention, new 4-hop) ≥.90, oracle 2/3-hop ≥.99, and original baseline two-hop <.50 in each fork motif. MULTIEDGE_COMPONENT_TRANSFER_WITHOUT_BASELINE_CONTRAST if candidates all pass but old baseline does not fail. Otherwise BOUNDED_MULTIEDGE_STORAGE_DID_NOT_RESTORE_COMPOSITION. Full NCI acceptance remains false regardless because writer/enumeration are programmed, not learned.
limitations: Same 576-byte pool and max seven edges, but multiedge writer changes occupancy policy, baseline has fewer active entries when overwriting, candidate join workloads can differ. Explicitly count calls; no equal-FLOP inference claim.
controls: Frozen source identity and dev-only qualification before sealed access
One original heldout first-use, artifact custody before interpretation
Full repository pytest and independent no-replay archive recomputation
No FORGE R32/R33, accepted refs, CKB/KTRADE/controller/production changes
